summary: @ornikar/postcss-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares preinstall: 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style renamed (_0x* identifiers, string-dictionary dispatch) and, at install time, downloads a Bun runtime archive from GitHub releases for the current platform, extracts and chmod+x's the binary, and execFileSync's it against math_init.js — a 727KB single-line obfuscated JS blob shipped in the tarball (numeric string-array + shuffled dispatcher). math_init.js is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose (a postcss configuration exposing four small plugin factories in index.js) and is referenced only by the setup.mjs dropper. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an opaque obfuscated sibling payload at npm install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern and is inconsistent with any legitimate use of a postcss config package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
